stories.headline: Alice Huang spy claim disputed by US officials as Singapore bars her entry

key_facts.fact: CNN reports US officials disagree on whether China had Alice Huang spy on Jensen Huang, with some at the ODNI and the CIA saying the intelligence to date does not prove it.
key_facts.excerpt: Sources: US officials disagree on whether China had Alice Huang spy on Jensen Huang; some at the ODNI and the CIA say the intelligence to date doesn't prove it

key_facts.fact: US Attorney General Todd Blanche said the DOJ has not yet reached a conclusion on whether Alice Huang was a Chinese spy and that "of course" the FBI is investigating.
key_facts.excerpt: US Attorney General Todd Blanche says the DOJ has not yet reached a conclusion on whether Alice Huang was a Chinese spy and "of course" the FBI is investigating

key_facts.fact: Singapore barred Alice Huang, described as the alleged spy and lover of the former Nvidia CEO, from entering the country.
key_facts.excerpt: Alice Huang, suposta espiã e amante de ex-CEO da Nvidia, é proibida de entrar na Singapura

key_facts.fact: InfoMoney reports the Chinese woman suspected of spying on the Nvidia CEO visited Taiwan eight times in two years.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinesa suspeita de espionar CEO da Nvidia visitou Taiwan oito vezes em dois anos

key_facts.fact: Times Brasil reports Alice Huang is linked to Huawei, Nvidia's biggest Chinese competitor.
key_facts.excerpt: Alice Huang está ligada à Huawei, maior concorrente chinesa da Nvidia

key_facts.fact: TecMundo reports Jensen Huang accepted going to the US Congress to clarify his relationship with the alleged Chinese spy.
key_facts.excerpt: Jensen Huang aceita ir ao Congresso dos EUA esclarecer relação com suposta espiã chinesa

stories.headline: NOAA: El Niño has a 60% chance of becoming the strongest since 1950, peaking into March 2027

key_facts.fact: El Niño is strengthening and has a 60% chance of becoming the most intense on record, according to Globo Rural's coverage of the NOAA update.
key_facts.excerpt: El Niño se fortalece e tem 60% de chances de ser o mais intenso da história

key_facts.fact: NOAA indicates the peak intensity of El Niño should extend until March 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Pico de intensidade do El Niño deve se estender até março de 2027, indica NOAA

key_facts.fact: Canal Rural reports NOAA reinforced that the phenomenon is historic, the strongest since 1950.
key_facts.excerpt: NOAA reforça fenômeno histórico, o mais forte desde 1950

key_facts.fact: Times Brasil reports El Niño is gaining strength and has a 60% chance of reaching a historic level, per NOAA.
key_facts.excerpt: El Niño ganha força e tem 60% de chance de atingir nível histórico, segundo NOAA

stories.headline: Iran's Guard says it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain, retaliating for a strike at Sirik

key_facts.fact: Iran's Revolutionary Guard (IRGC) says it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain as retaliation for an air strike on an Iranian telecommunications tower in Sirik.
key_facts.excerpt: O IRGC afirma ter destruído um radar americano no Bahrein como retaliação a um ataque aéreo contra uma torre de telecomunicações iraniana em Sirik.

key_facts.fact: The Guardian headlines the claim as a retaliatory strike: Iran says it destroyed a US military radar in Bahrain.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran says it destroyed US military radar in Bahrain in retaliatory strike

key_facts.fact: Iran also reported an explosion on an LNG ship in the Strait of Hormuz alongside the Bahrain radar claim, according to InfoMoney.
key_facts.excerpt: Irã relata explosão de navio de GNL em Ormuz e de sistema de radar dos EUA no Bahrein

key_facts.fact: ABC News carried the claim in its Mideast roundup, as the Revolutionary Guard said it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain, and other Mideast news
